Traceability's citation (collinear case) is nominal.

clauses.anchor: §4. Inputs, return values and stable error codes / item 4: “Must stably distinguish: `invalid_options`, `inv…”

clauses.anchor: §5. Stage state and identity / item 1: “Each player has at most one staging session, bou…”

clauses.anchor: §5. Stage state and identity / item 2: “The six-step order is strictly `source/origin`, …”
clauses.note: A skipped step returns bad_stage_order and the full six-step order is accepted. Reverse order and a repeated slot are not exercised.

clauses.anchor: §5. Stage state and identity / item 3: “`clear(request_id, player_id)` deletes only the …”
clauses.note: hidden:18 only checks that player B's session still exists after clear(A). It does not check that A's session is gone, the `cleared` code, the empty data table, or that budget/request history are untouched.

clauses.anchor: §6. Three-point geometry contract / item 1: “For each set of three points, X is the unit vect…”
clauses.note: collinear_frame is compared and the axis construction is pinned by the probe mapping (93,24,33). Despite the case name no zero-length axis (degenerate_frame) is passed, and non-retention of the failed third point is not checked.

clauses.anchor: §6. Three-point geometry contract / item 2: “`solve` expresses probe in local coordinates of …”

known_issues: Undisclosed adapter fields and hook names: suites use `S.HookPrefix`, `S.TimerName` and the suffixes `.CanTool`/`.Disconnect` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/integration/staged-prop-alignment-integration.lua:10,13,18,19; benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/server/staged-prop-alignment-suite.lua:11,12), and the stub `hook.Run` only consults the hook literally named `RheniumPropAlignment.CanTool` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/integration/staged-prop-alignment-integration.lua:2). The exam (T2-NATIVE-01) requires named hooks but publishes no name or field. A valid adapter with its own names fails the integration cases that index the hook table (install, CanTool denial, disconnect) and cannot complete Phase A, whose cleanup assertion concatenates the nil `S.HookPrefix`; the lifecycle case then passes vacuously because its leak scan only looks for the private name fragment and `timers[nil]` is nil. Measured by control alternative-strict-reading.

Undisclosed result fields: `data.stage` of stage() (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/hidden/staged-prop-alignment.lua:15) and `data.created` of Execute (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/integration/staged-prop-alignment-integration.lua:14). The exam defines neither.

Unbound player must return `invalid_trace` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/integration/staged-prop-alignment-integration.lua:12). T2-ADAPTER-02 lists invalid_trace, unbound_entity and invalid_context without mapping them to conditions; invalid_context is an equally valid reading.

Vacuous assertions: benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/hidden/staged-prop-alignment.lua:13 (quantization/detachment never observed), benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/hidden/staged-prop-alignment.lua:20 (`#sessions` comparison is 0==0 for keyed tables, no code compared), benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/integration/staged-prop-alignment-integration.lua:18 (`assert(true)`), benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/server/staged-prop-alignment-suite.lua:11-12 `authority` group (IsValid only), Phase B `constraint`/`rollback` groups (fresh-process trivia).

Fixture trap: the stub adapter environment has only include, hook, timer, IsValid, ents, constraint, undo and a `Vector` whose instances carry x/y/z and `AngleEx` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/integration/staged-prop-alignment-integration.lua:4,8). Angle(), Vector arithmetic, Vector:Angle(), CurTime, SERVER, util or isnumber are absent, so an adapter that builds the clone angle any other way than `Vector:AngleEx`, or touches those globals on the exercised path, errors in the integration layer while working on the real server.

Private save layout in Phase B: the persisted budget must be readable as `state.spent.A == 2` or `state.spent[1].count == 2` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/server/staged-prop-alignment-suite.lua:12). T2-PERSIST-01 only requires a complete `spent`; e.g. rows shaped {player_id, spent} fail.

Server-layer case granularity: the five-to-eight `server:` cases are the group verdicts of the FINAL phase (B) only (plugins/garrys-mod/src/rhenium_garrys_mod/addons/evaluator.py:255-276 reads `final_payload['cases']`). A failed Phase A assertion stops the run before Phase B (server_runner.py:631-640), so it is never recorded as `F` on its group: every `server:` case becomes unobserved (`U`), `complete` is false and the dedicated-server check scores 0/40. The Phase A group verdicts do exist in the raw execution record (`result.runtime.phase_a.payload.cases`) but are not part of the case table. Phase-A-only evidence therefore acts as a gate, not as a named failing case. For this task almost all engine-backed evidence (real PrimaryAttack, copy position, Weld, both undos, move) is in Phase A (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/staged-prop-alignment/server/staged-prop-alignment-suite.lua:10-11); the Phase B groups toolgun/geometry/constraint/move/authority/rollback only re-check bot/prop/STOOL presence and the persisted budget.
